items.difficulty_reason: 57 行、两段：Noetherian 情形用形式函数定理把推前的完备化写成各阶无穷小邻域截面之逆极限，在每一阶由「邻域与纤维同底空间」得到自洽的幂等元系统，取极限后说明它来自 stalk（完备化上幂等元可提升）；一般情形用「proper 有限展示的极限」把问题化到 Noetherian 情形。承重步骤（形式函数、自洽系统、极限归约）都在 span 内；6 处引用全跨章，作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-proper-idempotent-on-fibre (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 8333-8339

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the Noetherian case handled by the formal functions theorem producing a compatible system of idempotents on the infinitesimal neighbourhoods, and the general case reduced to the Noetherian one by a limit argument (source lines 8341-8397)
